title: Nourishing Cheesy Vietnamese Red Potatoes Ca Kho To
description: A comforting and flavorful Vietnamese dish featuring red potatoes, pickle, and a cheesy sauce, perfect for a sick day. This satvik-friendly recipe is a twist on the traditional ca kho to dish.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the cubed red potatoes with 1 tablespoon of vegetarian fish sauce and 1/2 teaspoon of black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the potatoes out in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes.
While the potatoes are roasting, heat 1 tablespoon of mustard in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped pickle and cook for 2 minutes, stirring frequently.
Stir in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 5 minutes.
Remove the potatoes from the oven and add them to the saucepan with the sauce.
Stir in the shredded cheese until it is melted and the sauce is smooth.
Season the ca kho to with salt to taste.
Transfer the ca kho to to a serving dish and garnish with chopped scallions.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
